content:
Payslip Earnings Item

Define earnings items for employee payslips.

Earnings include regular wages, overtime, bonuses, and other payments to employees.

Name

Enter a descriptive name for this earnings item, such as 'Regular Wages', 'Overtime', 'Bonus', or 'Housing Allowance'.

Expense account

Select the expense account where earnings will be recorded. This is typically a wages or salaries expense account.

Reporting Category

Select a reporting category to group this earnings item for reporting purposes. This helps in analyzing wage costs by category.

Inactive

Check this box to make the earnings item inactive. Inactive items won't appear in selection lists but remain in historical records.
